mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reason (user_id, tid, reason_type, reason_date, reason_tag, reason_text, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tid}, #{reasonType}, #{reasonDate}, #{reasonTag}, #{reasonText}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.rid, r.tid, r.reason_type AS reasonType, r.reason_tag AS reasonTag, r.reason_text AS reasonText, r.is_verified AS isVerified, r.is_deleted AS isDeleted, t.sid, t.trade_price AS tradePrice, t.quantity, t.total_amount AS totalAmount FROM reason r LEFT JOIN trade t ON r.tid = t.tid WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} and r.reason_date = #{reasonDate}

SELECT rid, user_id AS userId, tid, reason_type AS reasonType, reason_date AS reasonDate, reason_tag AS reasonTag, reason_text AS reasonText, is_verified AS isVerified, is_deleted AS isDeleted, created_at AS createdAt, verified_tid AS verifiedTid FROM reason WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND rid = #{rid}

SELECT r.rid, r.user_id AS userId, r.tid, r.reason_type AS reasonType, r.reason_date AS reasonDate, r.reason_tag AS reasonTag, r.reason_text AS reasonText, r.is_verified AS isVerified, r.is_deleted AS isDeleted, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.verified_tid AS verifiedTid FROM reason r JOIN trade t ON r.tid = t.tid WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND t.sid = #{sid} AND r.is_deleted = false AND r.reason_type = 'BUY' AND r.is_verified = false ORDER BY t.trade_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reason WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT rid, reason_tag AS reasonTag, reason_text AS reasonText, reason_date AS reasonDate FROM reason WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND verified_tid = #{tid} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY reason_date
